title: Card
description: A Marvel Snap card. Ability texts must come from the owner or the official game; never invent them.

cost.description: Energy cost; equals the turn on which the card can be played at minimum.

power.description: Base power before any ability modifiers.

archetypes.description: Archetype ids this card typically appears in. Used only as a prior for Stage A.

status.description: 'unknown_effect' means the card has abilities that the engine does not model yet. It widens the strength interval.

source.description: Where the ability text was taken from (owner note, in-game text, date). Required when abilities are present.

text.description: Ability text as written by the source. Optional while the effect is being implemented.

effect.description: Machine-readable effect in the engine DSL. Defined in engine/ at stage 1, step 4.
